author: OGGamer94
quote:
It's a pile of garbage with so much glitter on it that you can't clearly see the **** beneath all that glitter.

I'm sorry i have to do what? Fix the roof? Paint the walls? Rub some feet and listen to some girl-gossip while watching TV? I have to pay 100 bucks to be able to enter **** buildings? Oh yeah, 80 ain't enough for you to open up a **** door that is nothing but 0's and 1's that you can actually just choose to flip as a human. Look at this greed. And people eat it up like brain-dead monkeys.

We are talking about GRAND THEFT AUTO, hello? Honestly, every other indie game would have been ripped to pieces for everything this **** game is doing. **** FPS, **** gameplay, slow pacing, **** car controls.

People are trying to love it, because they are nostalgic, and because life is so **** they need that sensation just to forget about how **** life currently is. Not their fault i guess, but trying to love something just so you can finally have something in life that's worth living might be the best reason to question what the **** is going on in life right now.

They have us like addicted rats, they made us so addicted to the next great thing, the next distraction the next digital-orgasm that we literally want to forget about real life.

This is the perfect example of how humanity is NOT the most advanced species, when all that matters is that a few pixels on a **** screen turn on and off in a certain sequence to fool your brain into believing you have this grand adventure that finally gives you a reason not to give up on life. It's crazy honestly. And you call yourself "above monkeys" or whatever else. Look at you, gobbling up this pile of **** feminist **** because "iT's GrAnD tHeFt AuTo MaN!!11!!11!" **** Dopamine-Zombies. But this is exactly what they wanted, that's exactly what all the consumerism is made for, for you to become addicted zombie-brains.

This is capitalism at it's finest, it has no interest in making the world a better place, it has all its interest in making as much money as possible. And the best strategy to make all the money in the world is get people hooked. There you go, you have fallen for the trap of capitalism, and now you are eating up even the **** of product "just to finally feel something good". Wake up or go extinct, there is no in between anymore.
